note: Replaces the inline lowercase membership test for the Cloudflare allowlist with a call to the existing _model_matches_allowlist helper.
Adds private extract_string_with_fallback helper; extract_lib, extract_lib_version and extract_device_id all delegate to it (plus lib length truncation and tests).
Renames the ingestion lanes/ directory to pipelines/ (heatmaps, logs, ai, etc.) and updates imports and boundary checks accordingly.
Wraps the orphan-slot sweep loop in a HeartbeaterSync context manager instead of calling activity.heartbeat once per iteration.
Renames the signals source constants to VISION_SIGNALS_SOURCE_PRODUCT and VISION_SIGNALS_SOURCE_TYPE and updates their users.
Removes the standalone check-deleted-migrations job and moves the fetch and check steps into the repo-checks job, backed by a new helper script.
Drops the repetitive per-field if blocks; task field sync now lives in serializer update() iterating a field mapping and collecting changed fields.
Uses the cached self.user_permissions for the membership level check instead of building a fresh UserPermissions; also returns hidden flag.
Introduces StoreHandles, WorkloadContext and PhaseMetrics structs, passes them to phase/load functions and removes the too_many_arguments allows.
Replaces the duplicated flag-shaped interface with a distinct test-evaluation result type; duplication gone but FeatureFlagData is not reused.
Adds _require_int_param and _optional_int_param raising ValueError handled by _bad_request, used in pr_lifecycle, pr_runs, workflow_run, workflow_jobs.
Test raw SQL now picks the events table via a helper reading the HogQL context's new-schema flag, but query strings are still edited per test.
Adds capture_exception_throttled in posthog/utils and uses it from the flag-cache skip helper and the group type mapping failure path.
Only trims whitespace around comma-separated signing keys; module-level functions and config coupling remain, no signer class.
Adds an abstract sharded_tophog_base in the prod layer; prod-us and prod-eu tables extend it and only set their engine zoo_path.
Removes the frontend HogQL queries; adds a backend activity overview endpoint and the kea logic loads it and derives stats via selectors.
Extracts _resolve_start_offsets from drain_topic so the loop only polls; also adds kafka_io tests and a SASL host-override guard.
Replaces the inline manage.py shell heredoc with a new setup_local_gateway_credential management command plus tests, called from the script.
Moves the bot PRs flag check out of api.py into backend/feature_flags.py as is_slack_app_bot_prs_enabled and imports it.
Drops the hardcoded build_command default; field becomes nullable so the build worker infers the command from framework at runtime.
